facts.text: I have been dealing with a lot of health issues lately.
I want to prioritize my health and wellness.
I am open to any diet that is healthy and nutritious.
I am looking for meals that can help with immune system boosting.

I want to learn more about the probiotics Freshly uses in their meals.
I want to know the storage and reheating instructions for the meals.
I want guidance on how to maintain probiotic benefits during storage and reheating.
I want more details about the ingredients Freshly uses, specifically organic and non-GMO options.
